```python
import importlib
import pathlib
import sys
import tempfile
import textwrap

import dspy


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    tmp_path = pathlib.Path(tmpdir)
    module_path = tmp_path / "custom_module.py"
    save_dir = tmp_path / "saved_program"

    module_path.write_text(
        textwrap.dedent(
            """
            import dspy

            class MyModule(dspy.Module):
                def __init__(self):
                    self.cot = dspy.ChainOfThought(dspy.Signature("q -> a"))

                def forward(self, q):
                    return self.cot(q=q)
            """
        )
    )

    sys.path.insert(0, str(tmp_path))
    custom_module = importlib.import_module("custom_module")
    program = custom_module.MyModule()

    program.save(save_dir, save_program=True)

    sys.modules.pop("custom_module", None)
    sys.path.remove(str(tmp_path))

    try:
        dspy.load(save_dir, allow_pickle=True)
        raise AssertionError("Expected a missing-module failure when the custom module is only saved by reference")
    except ModuleNotFoundError as e:
        print("first_load_error:", e)

    sys.path.insert(0, str(tmp_path))
    custom_module = importlib.import_module("custom_module")
    program.save(save_dir, save_program=True, modules_to_serialize=[custom_module])

    sys.modules.pop("custom_module", None)
    sys.path.remove(str(tmp_path))

    loaded = dspy.load(save_dir, allow_pickle=True)
    assert loaded.cot.predict.signature == program.cot.predict.signature
    print("loaded_type:", type(loaded).__name__)
    print("loaded_signature:", loaded.cot.predict.signature)
```
